anomic.label: Anomic-like
anomic.goal: Communicate everyday ideas despite word-finding difficulty.

behaviour.word_finding: may search for a content word or describe around it when relevant
behaviour.repetition: relatively preserved; do not add repetition tests
behaviour.initiation: can initiate and elaborate on familiar topics
behaviour.self_repair: may retry a word or accept a cue; success varies
behaviour.semantic_error: possible but not a defining requirement
behaviour.phonological_error: not required; written dialogue cannot establish speech-sound accuracy

conduction.label: Conduction-like
conduction.goal: Convey intended meaning while managing word-form repairs.

behaviour.word_finding: may search for or revise a word form
behaviour.repetition: may be harder than understanding when naturally elicited; do not add a test
behaviour.initiation: can initiate and develop an everyday account
behaviour.self_repair: may make repeated word-form attempts with variable success
behaviour.phonological_error: possible in speech, but do not invent Chinese spellings to simulate sound errors

tcmotor.label: Transcortical motor-like
tcmotor.goal: Initiate and expand personally meaningful messages with support.

behaviour.grammar: may use simpler constructions without imitating English grammar errors
behaviour.sentence_length: may be short at first and expand with grounded support
behaviour.word_finding: may vary; naming failure is not required
behaviour.repetition: relatively preserved if naturally relevant; do not add a test
behaviour.initiation: may offer little spontaneous elaboration before a grounded follow-up
behaviour.self_repair: may revise an answer when given time or a cue

broca.label: Broca-like
broca.goal: Express useful information using manageable sentence structures.

behaviour.grammar: may use simpler Mandarin clauses; ordinary subject omission alone is not impairment
behaviour.sentence_length: may use short effortful phrases while still conveying a meaningful sequence
behaviour.comprehension: may follow simple contextual questions more readily than complex wording
behaviour.repetition: may be difficult if naturally relevant; do not add a test
behaviour.semantic_error: not required; do not insert unrelated content to signal a profile
behaviour.phonological_error: not required; written dialogue cannot establish speech-sound accuracy

wernicke.label: Wernicke-like
wernicke.goal: Maintain shared meaning and clarify occasional misunderstandings.

behaviour.grammar: surface sentence structure may remain intact even when meaning is unclear
behaviour.sentence_length: can vary; fluency does not require long replies
behaviour.word_finding: may vary; naming difficulty alone does not distinguish this profile
behaviour.comprehension: may misunderstand a relevant detail; allow a specific clarification and repair
behaviour.repetition: may be difficult if naturally relevant; do not add a test
behaviour.initiation: can initiate a response without implying shared understanding
behaviour.self_repair: may notice a mismatch or need partner clarification; success varies
behaviour.semantic_error: may choose a related but mismatched word or idea; not every turn needs an error
behaviour.phonological_error: not required; written dialogue cannot establish speech-sound accuracy

global.label: Global-like
global.goal: Express personally meaningful needs and preferences with substantial support.

behaviour.grammar: may rely on single words or short phrases while still conveying meaning
behaviour.sentence_length: often short; do not force every answer to the same length
behaviour.word_finding: may struggle with specific words without constant failure
behaviour.comprehension: may need short contextual questions and confirmation; not every exchange must fail
behaviour.repetition: may be difficult if naturally relevant; do not add a test
behaviour.initiation: may respond or start a simple meaningful request with support
behaviour.self_repair: may use a cue or partner confirmation to clarify meaning
behaviour.semantic_error: difficult to infer from sparse output
behaviour.phonological_error: not required; written dialogue cannot establish speech-sound accuracy
